description: Register for HDMF savings and qualify for affordable housing and multi-purpose loans.

blocks.content: **PAG-IBIG Fund**, officially known as the Home Development Mutual Fund (HDMF), is a government-owned savings and housing finance program in the Philippines. ([pagibigfund.gov.ph](https://www.pagibigfund.gov.ph/))
It helps Filipino workers save money and gain access to benefits such as:
Members contribute monthly to build savings while becoming eligible for various government-backed financial programs.
A PAG-IBIG Membership ID (MID) number is assigned to every registered member.

blocks.title: What is the difference between RTN and MID number?

blocks.content: The RTN (Registration Tracking Number) is temporary, while the MID number is the permanent membership number.

blocks.title: Can freelancers and self-employed individuals register?

blocks.content: Yes. Voluntary membership is available for freelancers, entrepreneurs, and self-employed individuals.

blocks.title: Is the PAG-IBIG Loyalty Card required?

blocks.content: No. The Loyalty Card Plus is optional but provides additional features and convenience.
